newsitem.title: USA: Proactive Technologies revises Q1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Proactive Technologies revises Q1 earnings.

text.p: Proactive Technologies Inc said it has revised its earnings per share figure for the three months ended September 30 to $0.08 per share, up from the $0.06 it reported previously.

It said the revised earnings per share came about as a result of amending first quarter earnings to reflect the recission of the agreement to purchase 82 percent of QuinStone Industries Inc. On November 16, the parties mutually agreed to rescind its original agreement.

The company also said it has a definitive agreement for James Preiss to become chief executive. Preiss is a former partner of company president Mark Conner, and co-developed more than $50 million in residential real estate with Conner from 1992 to 1995.
